title: 🚀 Trollas Inc OS enters development phase!
content:
🚀 Trollas Inc OS enters development phase!
🧪 We have completed the testing phase and officially begin the final development of Trollas Inc OS.
📱 Our first officially supported device will be the Xiaomi Redmi Note 8.
🌐 More information on our official website: https://bit.ly/trollasincos
